sector_model: commercial-stage biopharma: FCF after SBC, net cash, product concentration, patent and pipeline risk
thesis: Acadia Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ACAD) sells Nuplazid (Parkinson's disease psychosis) and Daybue (Rett syndrome). Q3 2026 net product sales 342.3M USD (+22.8% vs 278.6M); Nuplazid 202.2M (+13.9%), Daybue 140.1M (+38.6%); 9M revenue 918.3M (+16.6%), 9M operating income 104.9M vs 87.4M. TTM revenue 1,202.3M; TTM OCF 97.5M, capex 15.5M, FCF 82.0M, SBC 62.3M (FCF after SBC 19.7M). At 18.74 (2026-11-13 close; 52-week 15.86-30.96) market cap about 3.24B; cash 322.4M plus investment securities 654.1M = 976.4M with no debt line on the balance sheet, so EV about 2.26B: EV/sales 1.9x, EV/FCF 27.6x, FCF yield 2.5% (0.6% after SBC), EV/TTM operating income 18.5x. The reported TTM EPS multiple (about 9x) is not meaningful: FY2025 net income 391.0M includes Q4 2025 net income of about 274M, far above operating income, consistent with a large tax benefit (inference; valuation allowance release not read). 9M26 net income 88.7M after tax expense 42.2M (32.3%). The shares fell after the RADIANT Phase 2 miss on 2026-09-24 (primary endpoint p=0.0603), so the price embeds a weaker pipeline and a Nuplazid concentration discount; the commercial business itself is growing 17-23% with a net cash balance sheet.
counterthesis: Cash flow is small relative to the price: TTM FCF 82M is 2.5% of market cap and SBC consumes most of it; SG&A grew 25% in 9M26 (490.5M vs 393.3M) and 9M R&D is 234.7M. About 56% of 9M revenue is Nuplazid, whose generic-entry timing, patents and settlements were not read, and Daybue growth depends on a rare-disease base and a pricing and payer environment not yet checked. The Alzheimer's psychosis program (remlifanserin) missed its Phase 2 primary endpoint and Phase 3 spending continues. The head of R&D retired (8-K 2026-10-23, consultant to 2026-12-31). Low reported P/E is a tax artifact. 9M26 working-capital, rebate accruals and gross-to-net trends unread. A derivative suit settlement (preliminary approval 2026-08-24) was disclosed, terms unread.
invalidation: Thesis breaks if Nuplazid sales turn negative or generic entry is earlier than assumed, Daybue growth falls below about 15% with margin pressure, SG&A growth keeps outrunning revenue so operating income stalls, Phase 3 ADP studies fail after continued spending, or net cash is used on a dilutive acquisition.
